positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed the Transreality Interaction Platform (TrIP) to study the convergence of the Internet of Things with complex multi-modal interactive systems (Node.js, C, C++).
• Developed frontend TrIP clients providing 3D, Augmented, and Virtual Reality UIs for the Microsoft HoloLens, Oculus Rift, and HTC Vive (Unity3D/C#) and 2D UIs for the desktop and mobile-web (HTML5/JS, Electron, Bootstrap, WebSockets).
• Demonstrated TrIP at the UIST’16 Student Innovation Contest using HoloLens hand- tracking to detect interaction with virtual and physical (IoT) objects and a wearable muscle stimulator (based on ESP8266 WiFi microcontroller) to provide proprioceptive feedback (wrist flexion/extension) based on object state.

company.name: University of Central Florida - College of Engineering & Computer Science

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
• Assisted with R&D and day-to-day system engineering and development for the Ground Systems Development and Operations' Glass Wall project, which investigated the use of touchscreens, 3D User Interfaces (UIs), and 360° video in an Interactive Collaborative Environment for future Launch Control Centers.
• Proposed and implemented a proof-of-concept of a novel technology called the User Interface Database (UIDB) for integrating the variety of UI devices used in the Glass Wall project and improving decoupling between UIs and application logic.
• Developed multi-user touch-based 3D UIs using Unity3D and Node.js for Glass Wall and UIDB.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: • Developed a prototype Content Based Image Retrieval system using Java, OpenCV, and Lucene, to assist NASA scientists studying imagery of planets, moons, and asteroids.

company.name: University of Central Florida - College of Engineering & Computer Science

positions.title: M.S. Research
positions.description:
• A novel architectural paradigm for Ultra Large Scale systems called Harmony Oriented Architecture was developed to provide the scalability and evolvability necessary for building large-scale systems with self-star properties.
• Developed a proof-of-concept prototype HOA using a heavily modified version of Node.js to execute JavaScript modules in isolation and provide shared access to a spatial database and other system resources like networking and file system I/O.
• A spatial document database modeled after MongoDB was implemented to store the spatial relationships between modules and their persistent state using B+Tree and R*Tree implementations provided by the GiST library from UC-Berkeley.

company.name: University of Central Florida - College of Engineering & Computer Science

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
• Managed a multi-platform network of 150+ systems for a regional Internet- service provider offering Internet access, hosting, and on-site support to government, commercial, and residential customers.
• Virtualized legacy systems and migrated from multiple Windows and Linux platforms to a primarily Debian and Windows Server 2003 network in order to reduce hardware and administrative costs.
• Implemented a groupware solution supporting several thousand teachers and students requiring content and image filtering for mail traffic and meeting Florida public records archiving standards.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Assisted Dr. Kartik Gopalan with his team's early work on applying their network memory research to Xen virtual machines and implemented disk replication in the Anemone network memory driver.
• Assisted Dr. Ted Baker with instrumenting a real-time video processing application to provide performance data for his team's real-time scheduling research.
